summary: The deploy script is missing the shebang line (#!/usr/bin/env bash) which is required for the kernel to know which interpreter to use. Without it, the script may fail when executed directly. The rest of the script is well-structured with set -euo pipefail, usage function, and proper argument handling.

items.description: Missing shebang line at the top of the script. Add '#!/usr/bin/env bash' as the first line so the script can be executed directly (./deploy.sh) without explicitly invoking bash.
